commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) makes a strong challenge and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.
90+3' Flag up against Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

90+2' Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ollie Watkins, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
90+1' The game has come to an end for Noah Sadiki. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Daniel Neil (Sunderland).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) takes the corner with a short pass.
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) was quite harsh and Samuel Barrott didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' A nice individual effort by Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
84' Harvey Elliott (Aston Villa) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
82' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) replacing Boubacar Kamara.
82' The substitution is prepared. Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Morgan Rogers.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Enzo Le Fee trots off the pitch and is replaced by Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland).
80' Substitution. Chemsdine Talbi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Arthur Masuaku (Sunderland).
80' Here is a change. Wilson Isidor is going off and Regis Le Bris gives the last tactical orders to Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland).

75' 1 - 1 What a goal! Granit Xhaka plays it to Wilson Isidor (Sunderland), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Emiliano Martinez into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
75' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
74' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
73' That's the end of the game for Evann Guessand, who is replaced by Donyell Malen (Aston Villa).
73' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) tries to find Wilson Isidor, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.

67' 0 - 1 Boubacar Kamara slides a pass towards Matty Cash (Aston Villa) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the roof of the net. The score is now 0:1.
67' Aston Villa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
63' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
63' Corner kick. Trai Hume (Sunderland) is ready to send the ball into the box.
61' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Aston Villa.
61' Harvey Elliott (Aston Villa) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Aston Villa earn a corner.
58' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Emiliano Buendia is replaced by Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa).
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Harvey Elliott (Aston Villa) comes onto the pitch for Lucas Digne.
57' Samuel Barrott interrupts the game. One of the players from Sunderland won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
57' Sunderland will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
56' A dangerous looking corner kick from Trai Hume (Sunderland) is cleared to safety by the defence. Corner kick. Sunderland will have an opportunity.
53' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sunderland comes to nothing.
52' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
48' Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
48' Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

46' John McGinn (Aston Villa) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
46' Referee Samuel Barrott blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' A player from Sunderland commits a rough challenge. Samuel Barrott blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Aston Villa win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
42' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
41' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

39' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
37' A substitution has been made. Christopher Rigg is replaced by Daniel Ballard (Sunderland).

37' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Emiliano Martinez makes a comfortable save.
36' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
33' Reinildo Mandava (Sunderland) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
32' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) tries to find Christopher Rigg, but he puts too much power on the pass.
30' Samuel Barrott blows for a foul after Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
27' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

27' What a wasted opportunity by Evann Guessand (Aston Villa)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Robin Roefs makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
25' Aston Villa have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
24' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle. Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) commits a foul after dangerous play.
20' Omar Alderete (Sunderland) heads the ball towards goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort by making an easy save.
18' A corner kick by Sunderland is thwarted by the well prepared Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa).
18' A precise first-time shot by Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Sunderland are going to take it.
16' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.

13' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
9' Aston Villa quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
8' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) sends a long ball in, but Emiliano Martinez comfortably gathers the ball.
5' It will be a corner kick for Sunderland.
3' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) jumps into a tackle and Samuel Barrott signals a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Sunderland will have the kick-off.
